summary: Tested the Work board backend and frontend. Backend: 15/15 pytest pass after one fix. POST /api/posts/{id}/keen returned 500 every time because a timezone-naive datetime from Mongo was compared with datetime.now(timezone.utc). I fixed it in posts.py. Checked options (pay bands 20..180 step 10, max=min+20), create (job 14d, work 3d, negotiable pay), 422 validation, 402 for free users, 401 without auth, and visibility (hidden when not crew and no location, shown within ~5 km with distance_km, hidden beyond 25 km, shown to crew with is_crew=true). Also checked type and trade filters, keen (count 1, auto chat message, idempotent with no duplicate message, 400 on own post), responders shown only to the poster, mine=true, by-user, and close (404 for non-owner, then GET 404 and keen 404). Frontend at 390x844, all flows pass: Work tab with segments, trade chips and Post button; free user sees work-locked; compose -> detail ('Pay $50-70/hr', Close post) -> back -> My board shows the card -> open card -> Close -> card gone; crew member's Work board shows the post with a CREW badge; person page shows person-post-*; I'm keen -> 'You're keen · Open chat' -> chat shows the auto message; poster detail shows Keen (1) and post-responder row.

critical.issue: FIXED: returned 500 TypeError (can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes) because Motor returns naive datetimes. I now normalise expires_at to UTC before comparing (posts.py keen()).

minor.issue: The check-then-$push is not atomic. Two concurrent taps can add duplicate responders and send 2 messages. Use update_one({post_id, 'responders.user_id': {'$ne': uid}}, {$push}) and only insert the message when modified_count == 1.
_get_visible_post does not check expires_at, so an expired post can still be fetched by direct id (list endpoints filter it out correctly).
Posts from authors whose Pro has lapsed stay visible. Pro status is only checked when posting. Probably acceptable, but worth noting.

ui_bugs.issue: The poster's own trade is pre-selected. Tapping that chip (as a user naturally would) deselects it and disables Submit without saying why. Consider not toggling off on a second tap, or showing a hint.

issues: timeAgo floors at '1m ago', so a just-created post shows '1m ago'. Consider 'just now'.

action_items: Review my fix in /app/backend/posts.py keen(), where expires_at is now made tz-aware. Check other places that compare Mongo datetimes with aware datetimes.
Make keen atomic: conditional $push with 'responders.user_id' $ne, and send the message only if modified
Optional: return 404 for expired posts in GET /api/posts/{id}
Optional: raise touch targets for the Post button, segments and chips to 44px
Optional: don't let the pre-selected trade chip toggle off silently in new-post

To test as a third Pro user in the UI, insert a users doc with lifetime_pro:true, profile_complete:true and a user_sessions token.
rca_of_issue: keen 500: Motor (no tz_aware) returns naive datetimes for expires_at. Comparing with datetime.now(timezone.utc) raised TypeError. Reproduced every time via the pytest keen test. Fixed by attaching tzinfo=UTC when it is missing.
